ics.title: Subscribe in calendar
ics.intro: Sync billing dates to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook. A refresh every 6 hours is suggested; the actual interval depends on your calendar client. Alarms are relative to all-day events; their timing and display depend on the client.
ics.resetDone: Link reset. The old link no longer works.
ics.note: The link contains a private token — anyone with it can see your billing schedule. If it leaks, tap Reset link to revoke it.
